description: This file defines internal interfaces and a class related to grain call cancellation in Orleans, including methods for cancelling grain calls and managing cancellation requests.

classes.name: ExternalClientGrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Implements IGrainCallCancellationManager to handle cancellation requests for grain calls, utilizing a grain factory to obtain grain references.

methods.name: CancelRequestAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously indicates that a grain call should be canceled, given the sender's grain ID and message ID.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a specific grain call by invoking the cancel request on the target grain.
